name: Disrupt Concentration
description: Their sharp, shrill tongues and sharper claws make ink devils more distracting than their own combat prowess might indicate. As a bonus action, a creature can force a single foe within 30 feet of the creature to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or lose concentration until the beginning of the target’s next turn.
